entries.description: Continuation of a 22-acre homestead operated by two lesbians, producing bees, honey, rare poultry breeds, and lesbian/feminist goods, and offering apprenticeships in beekeeping and permaculture.
entries.raw_text: oriented homestead whose main farm income is from sales of bees and honey and from hatching rare breeds of poultry. Off-farm income is derived from graphic design, photography and writing for the organic agriculture journals. We also produce and sell lesbian/feminist t-shirts and rubber stamps under the name of Armadillo Mountain. Would welcome correspondence with other lesbians on the land. Longer-term apprenticeships/work exchanges are a possibility. Would also trade apprenticeships in beekeeping and Permaculture (particularly dryland and forage systems) for some good, solid vocational skills, especially carpentry and stone masonry. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 22 acres, good tools and equipment, dogs, cats, chickens, ducks, guineas, peabirds and 60 zillion bees.
entries.notes: Continuation from page 18; community_name left blank. Type is Private/Individual Land under two-woman rule ('2 lesbians', homestead with apprenticeships/work exchanges). num_residents left blank because this page segment does not include the questionnaire item 'women living and working on the land' or 'We live', though '2 lesbians' is listed. Lesbian women accepted inferred from 'Would welcome correspondence with other lesbians on the land.' Focuses coded from farm income and permaculture (Farming/self-sufficiency), apprenticeships (Workshops/education), producing t-shirts and rubber stamps (Archives/cultural work), and permaculture/organic agriculture writing (Environmentalism/eco-friendly).

entries.description: A 147-acre women's land community and farm caretaken by two lesbians, seeking donations and new members/caretakers to revive the community. Welcomes lesbian women, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children under 10.
entries.raw_text: OWL FARM POB 133, Days Creek, OR 97429. We are two wimmin caretaking OWL since Aug 82. OWL is needing energy and money support from wimmin to stay open for wimmin & children. No abuse of alcohol, drugs, or violence. I encourage wimmin of color to come and be here. We welcome: new members/caretakers, girl children, boy children (under 10 years), nonlesbian women, dogs only if restrained, donations. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 147 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, farm land, wimmin living and working the land. Inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because the resident caretakers are actively recruiting new members ('We welcome: new members/caretakers... Inactive group with hopes to revive'). num_residents is 2 from 'We have/are: 2 lesbians' and 'wimmin living and working the land'. Land city and state inferred from mailing address and OWL location in Days Creek, OR. Boy children accepted with restriction: 'boy children (under 10 years)'. Focuses coded: Recovery/substance-free ('No abuse of alcohol, drugs, or violence') and Women of color ('I encourage wimmin of color to come and be here').

entries.description: A land trust in the process of purchasing OWL Farm, holding quarterly trust meetings at the farm and publishing a newsletter. Welcomes new members, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children.
entries.raw_text: OREGON WOMEN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 1692, Roseburg, OR 97470. OWLT is in the process of buying OWL FARM (see above). Support for the farm and trust comes from donations from those women who believe in land for women. A quarterly newsletter is printed, $5/year. Land trust meetings are held about every three months at the farm. A collective of women (the number fluctuates) caretakes the farm. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women.
entries.notes: Type is Land Trust as explicitly named and described. Land location inferred from OWL Farm in Days Creek, OR ('in the process of buying OWL FARM (see above)... meetings are held about every three months at the farm'). num_residents left blank because 'the number fluctuates' and no specific count is given. Acreage left blank as it refers to '(see above)' rather than stating a figure.

entries.description: A community of four lesbians on a 40-acre secluded forest hilltop who grow food, create art and song, and host theatre and Tai Chi workshops for women. Closed to visitors outside of workshop times.
entries.raw_text: FLY AWAY HOME POB 593, Myrtle Creek, OR 97457. We are a family of 4 lesbians living on a secluded forest hilltop. We grow food and tender our emotional and spiritual depths. And we make art and song that celebrate woman. We invite women to our workshops in Theatre and in Tai Chi several times during the year. We are unable to welcome visitors at other times. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('a family of 4 lesbians living on a secluded forest hilltop'). num_residents is 4 from '4 lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land'. Land state OR inferred from Myrtle Creek mailing address. Non-lesbian women coded because general 'women' ('We invite women to our workshops') indicates all women before 1986. Focuses coded: Spirituality/ritual ('tender our emotional and spiritual depths'), Farming/self-sufficiency ('We grow food'), Workshops/education ('workshops in Theatre and in Tai Chi'), and Archives/cultural work ('we make art and song that celebrate woman').

entries.description: A 130-acre forested property owned and managed by a partnership of two lesbians, with a cabin, garden, chickens, and selective timber harvesting. Welcomes lesbian women, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children.
entries.raw_text: STEPPING WOODS Rt 4 Box 1058, Roseburg, OR 97470. We are a partnership of 2 lesbians owning 130 acres of forested property. We manage our woods by thinning and reforestation, where necessary, for selective timber harvest and firewood. There is one woman-built cabin, a few out buildings, a garden, chickens, and pets. We are not separatists and have male friends that come on our land. We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 130 acres, housing/permanent structures, electricity/privy, camping space, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under two-woman rule ('partnership of 2 lesbians owning 130 acres'). Land address copied from rural route address ('Rt 4 Box 1058'). num_residents is 2 from '2 lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land'. Stated rejection of separatism ('We are not separatists') noted but not coded. Visiting male friends noted but men not coded as accepted group since they are visiting friends and not on the welcome list. Farming/self-sufficiency coded from garden, chickens, and timber harvest/firewood management.

entries.description: A rural feminist publishing center on 6+ acres run by two lesbians, publishing Woman-spirit and The Blatant Image and engaging with photography, ecology, and alternative technology. Welcomes lesbian women and non-lesbian women for short or long visits and project assistance.
entries.raw_text: ROOTWORKS 2000 King Mountain Trail, Sunny Valley, OR 97497. A rural feminist publishing center (Woman-spirit and The Blatant Image) with strong interests in photography, (summer Ovulars), ecology and alternative technology. We are 57 & 60 years old. We enjoy the company and help of women of all ages who can adapt to our simple lifestyle for short or long visits. Rules: no men, guns, pets, drugs or dope. Smoking limited to outdoors gravel area. $4/day/woman includes vegetarian meals. We welcome: nonlesbian women, women to help on projects. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 6+ acres, housing/permanent structures, outdoor toilets, electricity with generator and batteries, camping space, woods, gardens, women living and working with the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under two-woman rule ('2 lesbians', hosting visitors and project helpers). Land address copied from road address ('2000 King Mountain Trail'). Acreage is 6 from '6+ acres'. num_residents is 2 from '2 lesbians' and 'women living and working with the land'. Explicit rule 'no men' noted. Focuses coded: Recovery/substance-free ('no... drugs or dope'), Archives/cultural work ('publishing center (Woman-spirit and The Blatant Image)'), Workshops/education ('(summer Ovulars)'), and Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('strong interests in... ecology and alternative technology').

entries.description: A notice that the Ozark Wimmin's Land Trust's multiple-ownership land ended in legal dissolution, though an active women's community remains in the Fayetteville area.
entries.raw_text: OZARK WIMMIN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 718, Fayetteville, AR 72702. We have tried multiple-ownership (partnership) type of land holding. The pieces of land wound up in legal dissolution eventually. Some of us persevere in the spirit. We cannot guarantee to answer letters, but if you are prepared to spend a little time in the area, a land search may be fruitful. A large wimmin's community exists.
entries.notes: Not a listing; notice that the community/land trust ended ('The pieces of land wound up in legal dissolution eventually').
